name: EMAG2v3_UpCont
label: EMAG2v3_UpCont
description:
EMAG2: Earth Magnetic Anomaly Grid (2-arc-minute resolution) - Upward Continued version. Values are in nT.
More information about EMAG2 at NCEI

name: EMAG2v3_SeaLevel
label: EMAG2v3_SeaLevel
description:
EMAG2: Earth Magnetic Anomaly Grid (2-arc-minute resolution) - Sea Level version. Values are in nT.
More information about EMAG2 at NCEI

name: EMAG2v3_Error
label: EMAG2v3_Error
description:
EMAG2: Earth Magnetic Anomaly Grid (2-arc-minute resolution) - Error estimate grid. The error estimate is in nT.
More information about EMAG2 at NCEI

name: EMAG2v3_Code
label: EMAG2v3_Code
description:
EMAG2: Earth Magnetic Anomaly Grid (2-arc-minute resolution) - Data source code. Values are stored as 16-bit integers. Code values are listed here.
More information about EMAG2 at NCEI

name: Multibeam Mosaic
label: Multibeam Mosaic
description: NCEI Multibeam Bathymetry Mosaic. The depth values are in meters, stored as 32-bit floating point values. The cell size is 3 arcseconds (approx. 90m).

name: Multibeam Mosaic Hillshade
label: Multibeam Mosaic Hillshade
description: Color shaded relief visualization of the NCEI Multibeam Bathymetry Mosaic. The cell size is 3 arcseconds (approx. 90m). The depths are represented using the color ramp shown below.

name: great_lakes
label: Great Lakes Bathymetry
description: Great Lakes Bathymetry (3-second resolution)

name: CRM Mosaic
label: Coastal Relief Model (CRM) Mosaic
description: Extract a grid from the NCEI Coastal Relief Models (CRM) Mosaic, a bathymetry/topography mosaic that includes NCEI-stewarded DEMs. The depth values are in meters, stored as 32-bit floating point values. The cell size of the CRM is 1 arc-second. More information about Coastal Relief Models at NCEI

name: CRM Mosaic Hillshade
label: Coastal Relief Model (CRM) Mosaic Hillshade
description: Extract a color shaded relief visualization from the NCEI Coastal Relief Models (CRM) Mosaic, a bathymetry/topography mosaic that includes NCEI-stewarded DEMs. The depth values are in meters, stored as 32-bit floating point values. The cell size of the CRM is 1 arc-second. More information about Coastal Relief Models at NCEI. The color scale is shown below.

name: ETOPO_2022 (Ice Surface; 15 arcseconds)
label: ETOPO_2022 (Ice Surface; 15 arcseconds)
description: Extract a grid from NCEI's ETOPO 2022 grid. This option will extract from the "Ice Surface" version that includes the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets. The cell size of this version is 15 arcseconds. For more information, please see the ETOPO 2022 User Guide.
